today.desc: a fast, customizable macOS space switcher
features: - Private macOS behaviour. The trackpad data, the synthetic swipe, the list of spaces and one of the screen captures are not public API. A macOS update can break any of them. It is developed and tested on macOS 27 only.
- No Mac App Store, no notarized download. That is why it is built from source.
- A short screen freeze at launch. macOS only draws the active space, so Interspace visits each space once behind a frozen picture to capture it. It takes about a second.
- A new desktop shows your wallpaper the first time you swipe to it. Use Capture All Spaces Again in the menu to avoid that.
- Mission Control. A swipe while Mission Control is open is not handled well.
- macOS asks again for Screen Recording from time to time. That is system policy for every app that captures the screen.
today.trDesc: 一款快速、可定制的 macOS 空间切换器
today.trFeat:
- 私有 macOS 行为。触控板数据、合成滑动、桌面列表和其中一张屏幕截图均不属于公共 API。macOS 更新可能会破坏其中任何一项。它仅在 macOS 27 上开发和测试。
- 没有 Mac App Store，没有经过公证的下载。这就是为什么它要从源代码构建。
- 启动时屏幕短暂冻结。 macOS 仅绘制活动空间，因此 Interspace 会在冻结的图片后面访问每个空间一次，以便进行捕获。这大约需要一秒钟的时间。
- 当您第一次滑动到新桌面时，该桌面会显示您的壁纸。请在菜单中使用“再次捕获所有桌面”以避免这种情况。
- Mission Control。在 Mission Control 打开时进行滑动操作无法得到妥善处理。
- macOS 会不时再次请求屏幕录制权限。 这是针对所有截屏应用的系统策略。

today.desc: Nanite-style virtual geometry (cluster LOD) for three.js: an offline GLB preprocessor and a WebGL2 runtime that works with stock materials.
features: - Turn a dense mesh (tested up to 1.97M triangles) into a hierarchy of 128-triangle clusters in 4 to 7 seconds.

- Pick detail per cluster from projected error in pixels, so one mesh can be coarse on its far side and fine on its near side with no cracks between the two. An offline crack test (three-nanite verify) is included.
- Frustum-cull per instance, per group and per cluster. Optionally occlusion-cull whole instances against an older depth buffer.
- Optionally stream geometry by level with HTTP Range requests.
- Draw many instances of each mesh with stock materials and stock shadow maps.
- Static, opaque, rigid meshes only. No skinning, no morph targets, no transparency sorting. Instance transforms are fixed when the batch is created and must use uniform scale.
- One material and one UV set per asset. The preprocessor keeps position, normal and TEXCOORD0, and the textures of the first material it meets. No tangents, vertex colours or second UV set.
- No geomorphing. Clusters swap instantly. At 1 to 2 px this was not visible in captured frames; at high thresholds or tight budgets it is.

- The coarsest levels look bad. When edge collapse gets stuck on UV seams the builder falls back to vertex clustering, which smears textures and merges thin parts. Expect this from about 8 to 10 px of effective error.
- Streaming is coarse. It loads whole levels per asset and never evicts. Nanite streams 128 KB pages of cluster groups.
- Occlusion culling is partial. Whole instances only, against depth that is a frame or more old, with no second pass, so newly revealed objects appear late.
- Shadows redraw the camera's cut. Triangle cost doubles and objects outside the view cast no shadow.
today.trDesc: 适用于 three.js 的 Nanite 风格虚拟几何体（集群 LOD）：一个离线 GLB 预处理器和一个与原生材质配合使用的 WebGL2 运行时。
today.trFeat:
- 在 4 至 7 秒内将密集网格（经测试最多可达 197 万个三角形）转换为由 128 个三角形组成的簇的层次结构。
- 从以像素为单位的投影误差中选择每个簇的细节，因此一个网格的远端可以粗糙，近端可以精细，两者之间没有裂缝。包含离线裂缝测试（三纳米验证）。
- 每个实例、每个组和每个群集的视锥体剔除。 可以选择根据较旧的深度缓冲区对整个实例进行遮挡剔除。
- 可选使用 HTTP Range 请求按级别流式传输几何体。
- 使用标准材质和标准阴影贴图绘制每个网格的多个实例。
- 仅限静态、不透明、刚性网格。无蒙皮、无变形目标、无透明度排序。在创建批次时，实例变换是固定的，并且必须使用统一的缩放。 - 每个资源一个材质和一个 UV 集。预处理器保留位置、法线和 TEXCOORD0，以及它遇到的第一个材质的纹理。没有切线、顶点颜色或第二个 UV 集。
- 无几何变形。群集即时交换。在 1 到 2 像素时，这在捕获的帧中不可见；在高阈值或预算紧张的情况下，则可见。
- 最粗糙的级别看起来很差。 当边坍塌卡在 UV 接缝上时，构建器会回退到顶点聚类，这会导致纹理模糊并合并薄的部件。预计有效误差约为 8 至 10 像素。
- 流式传输较为粗糙。它会为每个资源加载整个关卡，并且永远不会剔除。Nanite 流式传输 128 KB 的群集组页面。
- 遮挡剔除是部分性的。 仅限整个实例，针对一帧或更早的深度，没有第二次渲染，因此新出现的对象会延迟显示。
- 阴影重绘摄像机的裁剪。三角形成本加倍，视野外的物体不会投射阴影。

- 기존 HWPX를 스펙(JSON)으로 읽고 고친 뒤 다시 만듭니다.

- HWPX를 텍스트나 Markdown으로 꺼냅니다. 표는 Markdown 표로, 각주는 [^n]으로 바꿉니다.

- 이미지로 받은 양식을 다시 만드는 절차를 담았습니다. 선과 격자를 mm 단위로 재고 확인 목록을 쓰고 렌더링한 쪽을 겹쳐 비교합니다.

- 쪽 모양새를 점검하고 고칩니다(hd pagefit). 기본은 제목이 쪽 끝에 홀로 남거나 한 줄만 넘어가는 것 같은 최소한만 고칩니다. "읽기 좋게"라고 요청하면 readable 프로필로 읽다가 앞쪽을 다시 넘겨야 하는 곳을 없애고 쪽은 꽉 차게 맞춥니다.

week.desc: A live map beside the chat that shows what Claude Code is doing: tool calls, model steps, hooks, skills and subagents light up as they happen. Local only, in 7 languages.
features: - a file: the last two parts of its path;
- a web address: the host alone, without a login, password, path or query; an address that can be read two ways shows only its scheme;
- a shell command: the short description Claude wrote for it, or the command's name, never the command line. The description is the model's own words, and the mod shows them as written;
- a memory call: the tool's name and a record number or short identifier, never the text or the query;
- a memory command: its name, and the word after it only if you listed that word in memorySubcommands;
- a subagent: the short description it was started with;
- a background task's report: that the task ended and whether it failed, never its summary or its output;
- a hook's refusal: the name of the tool it stopped. Its first line shows only with hookReasons on, because a refusal may quote what the hook found.
week.trDesc: 聊天窗口旁边有一个实时地图，显示 Claude Code 正在做什么：工具调用、模型步骤、钩子、技能和子代理在发生时会亮起。仅限本地使用，提供 7 种语言。
week.trFeat:
- 文件：其路径的最后两部分；
- 网址：仅显示主机，不显示登录名、密码、路径或查询；对于可以两种方式读取的网址，仅显示其方案；
- Shell 命令：Claude 为其撰写的简短描述，或命令的名称，绝不会是命令行。描述是模型自己的话，Mod 会按原文显示； - 记忆调用：工具的名称和记录编号或简短标识符，绝不能是文本或查询；
- 记忆命令：其名称，以及其后的单词（仅当您在 memorySubcommands 中列出了该单词时）；
- 子代理：启动时使用的简短描述；
- 后台任务的报告：任务已结束以及是否失败，绝不会是其摘要或输出；
- 钩子的拒绝：其停止的工具的名称。 其第一行仅在hookReasons开启时显示，因为拒绝可能引用hook找到的内容。
